author: fable-cursor
criterion: Side by side with reference/frames/A_stairs.jpg the stairs, ledge, branch and plaza occupy the same screen regions and the eye reads the same composition.
note: Stairs (foot x 0.60-0.80, climbing to the upper right), the lantern branch (x 0-0.33 at y 0.30-0.36, pods at 0.21/0.26 vs the reference's 0.208/0.255), the plaza in the lower third and the fence line at the stair top all sit in the reference's regions; the eye reads Link -> stairs -> left branch as in the reference. Nits outside the criterion: the flight tops out at y 0.13 where the reference's does at 0.25 (20 treads read taller and steeper), and Saria's lit dome fills the centre (0.40-0.68 x 0.10-0.50) where the reference has misty depth, competing with the stairs for the eye; no shafts from the upper left (see W31).
